jobs.description: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Visa, a global leader in payments and technology, is at the heart of 259 billion transactions annually, connecting consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and governmental entities across 200+ countries. Our mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable, and secure payment network, empowering individuals, businesses, and economies to thrive. Our unified purpose is to uplift everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. Join our purpose-driven company and make an impact. Experience Life at Visa. The Role This Product Manager role sits within Visa Direct’s Currencycloud product, focused on building the infrastructure that powers how money moves globally. You’ll help businesses send, receive and manage funds across borders quickly, cheaply, and with full transparency and control. Money movement sits at the heart of how businesses and consumers operate, so the work you do here has real, measurable impact. You’ll own a product area end to end, working with a dedicated engineering team and cross-functional partners to decide what matters most and how to move it forward. You’ll shape the vision and roadmap for your area based on client needs, business goals, market context and what you learn through discovery. You’ll spend time understanding how clients use our products, where the experience breaks down, and where we can create something better. From there, you’ll define and launch features, stay close to how they perform in the real world, and use data, feedback and judgement to decide what to do next. We’re looking for people with high agency, who take initiative, create clarity and don’t wait for perfect direction. You’ll have space to own problems end to end, influence beyond your immediate team, and deliver meaningful outcomes with your team. This role reports into a Product Director or Group Product Manager. Responsibilities Strategy and Vision: Collaborate in crafting your tribe’s strategy by doing deep market, customer, competitor and technology research. Develop a product strategy and roadmap for your team based on company strategy, tribe strategy, deep market, customer, competitor and technology research. Build alignment and secure buy-in for the product strategy from colleagues and stakeholders. Turn strategy into a clear, prioritised backlog and roadmap for your team. Discovery: Lead discovery with clients to uncover real problems, unmet needs and new opportunities Work with customers and colleagues to generate, test and refine ideas for new features and products. Go deep on payment flows, bank and operational processes, and systems maps to understand how things work end to end. Work with internal & external teams to develop and maintain clear technical documentation Ensure requirements are detailed enough to take into sprint, including functional & non-functional requirements Use what you learn from customers and data to separate signal from noise, challenge assumptions, and focus the team on the highest-impact problems. Delivery: Manage end-to-end product development, from shaping the problem through to building and launching it for our clients. Prioritize the product backlog based on customer, commercial, and strategic value, potentially across more than one scrum team Partner closely with engineering and delivery counterparts to keep the team focused, effective and moving at pace. Give clear context on what is being prioritised and why, so the team can make good decisions quickly Adoption: Collaborate with the Product Marketing and GTM teams to define the go-to-market plans, positioning and launches. Drive product adoption across various regions, segments, and use cases, not just releasing features. Measure product performance and impact after launch and use data and insight to decide what to improve, scale or stop. What Success Looks Like A clear strategy, roadmap and backlog that connect customer problems to business outcomes. Features and improvements shipped at pace that solve real problems and create measurable value. Strong product judgement, shown through good prioritisation, clear trade-offs and thoughtful use of data. Owning a product area that is gaining adoption, performing well and improving over time This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic Qualifications You don’t need to tick every box to apply, but this role will be a strong fit if you have most of the following: At least 3-4 years proven experience in a Product Owner/Product Manager role, preferably in a software-first Fintech or tech start-up Experience owning a product area or major initiative from discovery through launch and iteration. Experience shipping products and can clearly demonstrate impact by moving key customer and business metrics. Strong prioritisation skills, with the ability to define and manage a backlog and make tough trade-offs. 쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는
여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

jobs.description: Position Overview Apollo Global Management is seeking an Associate to join its Investment Operations team, with primary responsibility for Security Master and Investment Reference Data management across the insurance platform. This role sits at the core of investment operations, ensuring the accurate setup, governance, and synchronization of securities and reference data across multiple internal platforms. The Associate will be responsible for interpreting governing documents, validating key economic terms, and maintaining the integrity of security data that supports trading, accounting, risk, and reporting functions. Given the breadth of Apollo’s platform and the complexity of private credit and structured products, this role requires strong operational judgment, attention to detail, and an understanding of end-to-end investment workflows. Primary Responsibilities Lead the setup and ongoing maintenance of private and structured securities within internal Security Master platforms. Perform detailed review of Credit Agreements and governing documents to extract and validate key security terms (e.g., issuer, coupon, payment dates, amortization schedules, covenants). Ensure accurate synchronization of security reference data across multiple systems, including Everest, VPM, Markit EDM, Thinkfolio, and PAM. Partner with deal teams, traders, portfolio managers, Insurance oversight, and Quant teams to validate new security setups and resolve discrepancies. Maintain and troubleshoot Residential Mortgage Loan (RML) and Commercial Mortgage Loan (CML) security records, ensuring completeness and accuracy. Execute reconciliations and data quality controls to preserve the integrity of investment, accounting, and reporting outputs. Support testing and implementation efforts related to system enhancements, integrations, and workflow improvements. Serve in a lead or supporting capacity on cross-platform operational initiatives impacting Security Master and reference data processes. Identify opportunities to strengthen controls, improve automation, and enhance data governance within the Security Master function. Qualifications & Experience Required Undergraduate degree with 3–6+ years of relevant experience in investment operations, security master, reference data, or asset servicing. Experience setting up and maintaining fixed income, private credit, or structured product securities. Ability to read and interpret Credit Agreements and other governing documents to extract key economic and structural terms. Strong understanding of security lifecycle events and downstream operational impacts (trading, accounting, reporting). Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Demonstrated attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and ability to operate with urgency in a deadline-driven environment. Comfort communicating directly with traders, portfolio managers, and cross-functional stakeholders. Preferred Experience with mortgage products (RML and CML). Familiarity with Security Master or reference data platforms such as VPM, Everest, PAM, Thinkfolio, or Markit EDM. Experience with Bloomberg and credit rating agencies (S&P, Moody’s, Fitch). Exposure to insurance asset management or separately managed account platforms. Experience participating in system implementations or workflow redesign initiatives. jobs.description: Job Details: Job Description: Our team is dedicated to optimizing Intel’s cutting-edge process technology to meet the rapidly evolving needs of next-generation silicon designs. The Epic Operational Database Administrator (ODBA) is a mission-critical, hands-on role responsible for the installation, performance, and reliability of the Epic IRIS Operational Database (ODB) hosted in Microsoft Azure. Operating in a high-volume, national-scale diagnostic laboratory environment, the ODBA will transition the system through its initial implementation, stabilize it during steady-state operations, and continuously optimize database performance. This role works closely with infrastructure teams, integration engineers, and Epic Beaker analysts to ensure massive daily volumes of clinical testing data flow with zero interruption and strict adherence to healthcare compliance standards (HIPAA, CLIA). Responsibilities: Install, configure, and provision all Epic database environments (Production, Reporting, Disaster Recovery, Training, and Build) within the Azure cloud environment. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Collaborate with cloud engineers to deploy and manage the underlying Azure database infrastructure using tools like Terraform to ensure consistent, scalable builds. Execute rigorous volume testing to ensure the database can handle burst-heavy, high-throughput HL7v2 and FHIR API transactions from automated lab analyzers and middleware. DR Configuration: Implement and validate multi-region disaster recovery, failover clusters, and backup protocols to guarantee near-zero downtime and strict data recoverability prior to go-live. Monitor daily database health, server performance, I/O, and journaling to proactively identify bottlenecks and maintain high availability. Execute routine Epic version upgrades, system updates (SUs), and security patches across all environments according to strict change management processes. Serve in a 24/7 on-call rotation to provide advanced troubleshooting for database abends, slow query responses, data corruption, or severe system degradation. Execute daily operational tasks, including database space management, user access control, log rotation, and validation of automated database backups. Act as the primary technical liaison with Epic Technical Support (Epic TS) and InterSystems to coordinate maintenance windows and drive resolution of critical incidents. Continuously tune database memory, caching, and background processes to optimize responsiveness for rapid specimen accessioning, auto-verification, and integrated LIS workflows. Monitor storage consumption and transaction trends to accurately forecast resource needs and right-size Azure compute/storage resources for cost efficiency and performance. Design and execute database partitioning and historical lab-result archiving strategies to manage the rapid, compounding data growth typical of a national reference lab. Process Automation: Develop and refine automation scripts to streamline repetitive DBA tasks, system monitoring alerts, and failover validation processes. Qualifications: Required Qualifications Active Epic ODBA certification is required with a proven track record of maintaining certifications across multiple Epic release cycles. Minimum 7+ years of hands-on database administration experience managing InterSystems Caché/IRIS database environments, with a strong focus on enterprise-scale production systems. Demonstrated experience of managing, monitoring, and performance-tuning databases supporting high volume concurrent users and extremely high transaction volumes. Minimum 4 years of deep operational experience hosting and managing mission-critical Epic database workloads within Microsoft Azure, including advanced knowledge of Azure storage performance tiers and VM clustering. Expert level experience designing, configuring, and executing failovers for multi-node, geographically distributed high-availability database configurations and complex disaster recovery plans. Advanced Unix/Linux system administration skills (specifically Red Hat Enterprise Linux) with the ability to write sophisticated, production-grade automation scripts (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) to manage large environment fleets. Proven experience designing and validating backup and restore strategies for massive databases, ensuring zero data loss and minimal recovery time objectives under pressure. Exceptional root-cause analysis skills with a demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve complex database corruption, severe performance degradation, or system abends in real-time. Commitment to participating in a flexible, 24/7/365 tier-3 escalations on-call rotation for critical database incidents. Preferred Qualifications Large Diagnostic/Lab Network Experience: 10+ years of senior-level Caché/IRIS DBA experience, with specific experience in a national reference laboratory, massive multi-tenant healthcare system, or highly integrated diagnostic network. Deep technical knowledge of optimizing and tuning IRIS databases specifically to support high-throughput Epic Beaker (Clinical and Anatomic Pathology) workflows and massive interface transaction loads. Advanced experience automating database environment provisioning and configuration management using Terraform, Ansible, or similar enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines. Proven experience designing and implementing advanced database partitioning, purging, and historical archiving strategies to manage aggressive, high-volume laboratory data growth. Prior experience serving as the Lead ODBA for a major, enterprise-wide Epic Go-Live, successfully guiding the database environment from build to steady-state optimization. Active, advanced Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Database Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect, or DevOps Engineer Expert). Technical Training or Professional Licensing: Active Epic Operational Database Administrator (ODBA) Certification: Must hold an active, non-expired Epic ODBA certification (Required) Epic New Version Training (NVT): Must be fully current on all Epic NVTs up to the organization's target Epic release version to ensure they are qualified to manage and upgrade the environment immediately upon hire. (Required) InterSystems System Administration Certification (Preferred) Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Healthcare Administration, or equivalent professional work experience.
